reviews.comment: Had him for Linear Algebra. He talks super fast 2x speed and mostly faces the whiteboard. No slides, so you must choose between taking notes or listening and he's blocking the board half the time. Canvas is disorganized and missing files. His handwriting is hard to read, I often had to ask what he wrote. Content itself is fine but he makes it hard.

Dr.Young really knows his stuff. The lectures were very insightful. The weekly homework was alright. The difficulty of which was about on-par with what a typical 400 level class is. The topics were skewed closer to number theory more than I was hoping for. I recommend the reading since the textbook used. Is a very well known and famous one.

Matthew is a funny and passionate professor, and I really enjoyed his class.  The assignments were very fair, and he was very accessible and helpful in office hours for the problems that I found tough.  His lectures were great and he is overall a good person.

Dr. Young is a funny guy and a great professor. It is evident that he is very passionate about the subjects which he teaches. He is not in the business of giving out good grades for free; you will most likely have to go above and beyond the typical level of effort in order to get an A, but you'll learn a lot on the way. Lots of HW, fair grader.

He gives you all the information you need to make an easy A, including practice tests that are very similar to the real tests. Make sure to remember definitions, too. Lectures are paced well and easy to follow along with. Dr. Young is a funny guy.
